kind_of_no: long-stay park, no nights for sale (test 2); no price or presence
why: Private park on SD-50 just north of Chamberlain whose own Google Maps listing is titled 'Hilltop Campground (yearly leased sites and storage units)' (gm.py, read 2026-11-22: phone +1 605-680-4104, no website, no rating or reviews). No operator site, booking engine, posted rate or nightly offer was found anywhere (web searches 2026-11-22). The 2025 news item that named it (The Daily Republic via Yahoo, 2025-04-18) describes '90 lots' built in 2023 that have been slow to fill. Yearly leases with no nights for sale fail long-stay test 2, and there is no price indicator or presence indicator either.
name: Hilltop Campground
flags: Google Maps (gm.py, read 2026-11-22): name 'Hilltop Campground (yearly leased sites and storage units)', pin 43.8431896,-99.2981471, address on SD-50, Chamberlain SD 57325, phone +1 605-680-4104, no website, no rating or review count shown.

allcampsandparks.com directory page (read 2026-11-22) mirrors the Google listing: the same name, address and phone, 'yearly leased sites and storage units', and no rates, amenities or website. Its 'Tent Sites' type is a directory default, not evidence.

News: 'Chamberlain a recreational destination, but not for this unwelcomed campground', The Daily Republic (Mitchell SD), syndicated on Yahoo, 2025-04-18. It says the owner worked on the project from 2016, 'finally got it built in 2023', and that 'His campground features 90 lots', which have been filling slowly. It says nothing of nightly stays.
Not in campgrounds.json by name, and nothing within ~2 km of the pin (the nearest entry is 15756 American Creek, about 3.7 km SW). Checked 2026-11-22.
Not confused with Campendium's 'Hilltop Motel & Campground' (5 sites, 605-649-7622). That is a different business; the 649 prefix points to another town.
No satellite read and no waterfront audit were done: the skip does not depend on the site.
